---
title: "Welcome to Ana Paula Andreazzi"
description: "Ana Paula joins the lab to study how stingless bees respond to heat waves in urban ecosystems."
date: "2024-07-15"
categories: [news, people]
---

We gave a warm welcome to **Ana Paula Andreazzi**, who joins the lab as a
PhD student. Ana Paula will be testing how **stingless bees respond to heat
waves in urban ecosystems** in the Tropics.
